blurb: Guests enjoy a relaxed wine tasting experience guided through current vintage wines with views of the vineyard and Okanagan lake. The winery focuses on small-scale, quality grape farming and minimal intervention winemaking. They offer wine club memberships with shipments and special access to limited wines.
extraNote: Minimum purchase of 6 bottles for wine orders · Receipt of shipments requires signature of a sober adult of legal drinking age · Wine is perishable and not replaced if damaged by extreme weather during shipment · Tasting room at 1285 Smethurst Road, Naramata, BC
